INCLUSION TEST USED (set before records): base = a quoted source says the company or site supplies welded structures (weldments, frames, tanks, cabs/ROPS, counterweights) to construction or mining equipment OEMs; mixed ag + construction = base, noted; excluded = quoted source shows ag-only, logistics/office-only, or out-of-vertical work; a shop merely near an OEM plant with no such statement = lead only (listed below), no record.
Company-level statements applied to a plant are tagged inferred with reasoning. Tier 1 is stated only for Super Steel (it calls itself 'tier one'); every other tier is inferred. Relationship: lookalike Mine Rite for tank makers (Helgesen/Standard Iron Hartford x2, Engineered Welding) and Metalcraft (tanks, buckets, mining weldments, company-level); all others new. No plant is a Path customer.

A Dallas Robot Programming Specialist role is open. Welding at either site is not confirmed. Superior Tube Products work moved into Morton IL and Dunlap TN on 2026-01-01. Raleigh (likely the 2025 Accu-Fab data-center acquisition) and Fond du Lac (likely the Mid-States Aluminum extrusion site) are kept as base, but the 10-K does not tie either acquisition to a city: profiler to check, and they may move to data centers or aluminum-only exclusion. Beaver Dam West's only weld posting is an aluminum welder, and its FRS name is 'Phoenix Coaters West'. MEC Wautoma WI is held for sale (10-K); there is no record. Metalcraft West Bend is 'new', not lookalike: the only site-level evidence is Scag mower welding. Standard Iron Monticello HQ excluded (architectural metals and office roles only). JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Welder 2 

Reports to: Weld Supervisor
Job Code: Hourly
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
Direct reports: No
 
 
 
SUMMARY:
Plans, positions, and welds fabricated and cast components on roll over/fall over protective structures, and specialized weldments. Performs work primarily on ROPS/FOPS structure welds completing all required welds except critical joints, including sheet metal welds. Position also utilizes full-penetration welds with a backing material.
 
 
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Produces a product to customer quality standards in a safe and efficient manner.
* Receives and reviews instructions, prints, and work order for the job.
* Lays out, positions, bolts, clamp, and tack-weld parts to secure into position within fixture for welding.
* Sets up and makes adjustments to equipment and parts per blueprints.
* Performs welding responsibilities on product outlined in Blueprints; OPI's, Quality Manual, or any additional performance guidelines.
* Grinds excess weld, sharp corners, or sharp protrusions using a portable pneumatic grinder.
* Makes periodic quality checks as required and inspects finished product for completeness.
* Other duties as assigned
 
 
KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:
* Required to obtain weld certification to AWS/ANSI standards.
* Basic knowledge of welding procedures,
* Capability to read and interpret blueprints, work order instructions; weld symbols, and operate required tools involved in position.
* Good problem-solving skills, safety practices and attention to quality.
* Ability to convert standard units of measure to metric and metric to standard in addition to basic math skills.
* Able to consistently maintain production averages at or above the expected standards.
 
 
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:
* Minimum of a high school diploma or GED
* Successful completion of Crenlo Engineered Cabs weld training program requirements
* Crenlo basic safety training
* 1 to 2 years welding experience
 
Note: If a Weld 2 classified welder has not completed Weld 2 job duties within 6 months, welder must complete Weld 2 re-certification prior to performing Weld 2 job responsibilities.
 

WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER:
* Physical Requirements statement(s)
* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities.

Employees are held accountable for all aspects for the job, which are subject to change at any time. An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. GENERAL SUMMARY: 

Required to operate a robot, perform all position welding and operate all hand and air tools as needed.  Operate material handling equipment when necessary, perform daily and routine maintenance, replenish parts via Kan Baan and visual trigger.  Maintain 5s improvements, CI improvement, safety, quality, efficiency.  Learn numerous weld processes on multiple jobs. 

 

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Operate welding robot per authorized instruction.
  • Verify robotic welds are located and sized per print specification.
  • Operate weld equipment as directed by Supervisor.
  • Perform all position and types of welding including certified.
  • Record robotic downtime, labor and job data accurately.
  • Maintain quality, safety and efficiency.
  • Maintain clean and neat work area.
  • Perform other jobs within the department or plant as required by supervision.

 

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND QUALIFICATIONS:

 

EDUCATION:

High school diploma or equivalent preferred.  Equivalent of one year acceptable welding experience, one year of technical college, Company welding course, or equivalent training.  Must have held “A” Welder position for 75 days minimum.  Must have passed welder certification test and have stamp.  Successfully pass the internal robot training course. 

 

WORK EXPERIENCE:

Prior experience in a manufacturing environment is beneficial.  Equivalent of one year acceptable welding experience preferred or satisfactorily completing the Company welding course.

 

SKILLS:

A good command of the English language is required, both written and spoken.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills are required.  Possess the ability to set up and operate welding machines.  Ability to read and understand prints, bills of material, ARI and safety notices.  Responsible and accountable for completing all job and safety-related checklists.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Must be able to physically perform essential functions of the job.  Must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10 lbs. and frequently up to 50 lbs.  Typically requires standing on a regular basis and walking, sitting, climbing, stooping, crouching, reaching and handling occasionally.  Specific vision requirements include depth perception and peripheral vision. 

 

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Regularly exposed to noise, odors, dust, chemicals, temperature extremes, hazardous substances, drafts, vibration and electricity.  Typically requires the use of welders, hand tools, hoists, cranes, saws, all air tools, grinders, die grinders, orbiters, and drill presses.  Hearing protection, safety glasses, steel-toed shoes with metatarsal protection, face shield or goggles, welding helmet and gloves are required.

 

 

This position description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and competencies required of this position.  Employees are held accountable for all aspects for the job, which are subject to change at any time.

Summary

The IT Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, and supports the infrastructure behind Crenlo's plants in Watertown, SD, Rochester, MN, and Greeneville, TN, and the corporate office in Bentonville, AR. The role owns systems, including VMware, Windows Server, Linux, Microsoft 365, backup, and datacenter operations. On the network side, the engineer is the next-level resource for escalation, design, engineering, and implementation, while the Network Administrator runs day-to-day operations.

Production runs on this infrastructure, so uptime, security, and fast recovery are the core of the job. The role reports to the IT Operations Manager and works closely with the helpdesk and Network Administration.

The ideal candidate is the person others call when something is truly broken, and who then makes sure it doesn't break the same way twice. They are comfortable on a manufacturing floor, can explain technical problems in plain terms, and keep good documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Systems, Virtualization, and Microsoft 365

  • Administer VMware vSphere/ESXi, including host builds, capacity planning, and patching
  • Maintain Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP
  • Maintain Linux servers (RHEL, Ubuntu) and the SQL Server hosts that run business applications
  • Administer Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and licensing
  • Automate routine work with PowerShell and Bash

Backup, Recovery, and Datacenter Operations

  • Own Veeam backup and replication, including restore testing and offsite and immutable copies
  • Build and test disaster recovery plans for production-critical systems
  • Run datacenter operations (power, cabling, storage capacity, hardware lifecycle) and support consolidation and colocation moves

Network Engineering and Security

  • Design and implement network infrastructure across all sites, including Fortinet firewalls, SD-WAN, Dell core switching, and Ubiquiti UniFi firewalls, switching and wireless
  • Set network standards and design segmentation that keeps production equipment, industrial controls, and IoT devices separate from business networks
  • Plan wireless for offices and production floors, and lead SD-WAN and WAN changes with carriers
  • Hand off completed builds to the Network Administrator with documentation, and provide backup coverage when needed
  • Work with IT Security on firewall policy, access controls, and incident response

Operations, Projects, and Team

  • Act as the Tier 3 escalation point for the helpdesk, fix root causes, and share fixes so more issues get solved at first contact
  • Coordinate with the IT Operations Manager and IT team on priorities, maintenance windows, and change control
  • Lead infrastructure projects from design through cutover
  • Manage infrastructure vendors and carriers to their SLAs, and provide input on purchases and capital planning
  • Keep diagrams, configurations, runbooks, and SOPs current

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on infrastructure experience covering both systems and networking
  • Hands-on VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
  • Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365/Entra ID administration
  • Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu, or similar) and PowerShell/Bash scripting
  • Veeam or comparable backup experience, including restores and DR testing
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and VPN
  • Datacenter operations experience: servers, storage, power, and cabling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Manufacturing or industrial experience, including OT networks, PLCs, or SCADA
  • Hands-on experience with Fortinet firewalls and SD-WAN
  • Enterprise wireless and switching experience with Ubiquiti UniFi or a comparable platform
  • Certifications such as VCP-DCV, Fortinet FCP/NSE, CCNA, Veeam VMCE, Microsoft 365/Azure administrator, or RHCSA
  • Datacenter migration or colocation experience
  • ITSM experience (Freshservice preferred) and familiarity with NIST CSF or CIS Controls
  • Uses AI tools such as Claude to speed up scripting, documentation, and troubleshooting

Key Competencies

  • Service First mindset: responsive, follows through, and keeps people informed
  • Troubleshoots to the root cause and stays calm when production is down
  • Team player who shares what they know and keeps teammates in the loop
  • Communicates clearly with plant staff, leadership, and vendors
  • Disciplined about documentation and handles multiple priorities independently

Working Conditions

  • Based in Bentonville, AR, with up to 20% travel between Crenlo facilities
  • On-call rotation and after-hours maintenance required
  • Exposure to manufacturing floor environments and ability to lift equipment up to 50 lbs

SUMMARY

Crenlo is seeking a high-output Production Supervisor to drive daily production results and continuous improvement within our Manufacturing team.

This role is responsible for owning line performance — safety, quality, delivery, efficiency, and material flow — and delivering results through disciplined execution, problem solving, and accountability..

 

Salary Compensation: The compensation range for this position is $75,747 - $91,066 annually.

 

The Production Supervisor is expected to:

  • Run the floor, not observe it
  • Identify problems early and solve them fast
  • Drive both hourly teams and salaried support functions to deliver results
  • Maintain control of materials, inventory accuracy, and system transactions 

This is a hands-on leadership role for individuals who take ownership and operate with urgency.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (What You Will Be Measured On)

Safety

  • Enforce safety standards with zero tolerance for unsafe behavior
  • Act immediately to correct hazards and drive a proactive safety culture

Production Execution

  • Own daily schedule attainment with no surprises
  • Adjust labor and priorities in real time to maintain flow and hit targets

Labor Efficiency

  • Drive labor efficiency through proper staffing, line balance, and waste elimination
  • Continuously improve Direct Labor Efficiency through disciplined execution

Floor Leadership

  • Maintain a strong, visible presence on the production floor
  • Identify issues early and act immediately to prevent disruption

Problem Solving

  • Lead root cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions
  • Eliminate recurring issues instead of managing symptoms

Accountability

  • Hold team members accountable for performance, attendance, and quality
  • Coach, train, and take corrective action when standards are not met

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Drive urgency and follow-through from Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Materials
  • Escalate and resolve issues that impact production without delay

Material Flow and Inventory Control

  • Own material flow and inventory accuracy with no production loss due to system or inventory errors
  • Ensure accurate, real-time material transactions including receipts, moves, issues, and completions
  • Maintain alignment between physical inventory and ERP system records
  • Prevent disruptions caused by shortages, mis-picks, or inaccurate inventory

Continuous Improvement

  • Implement measurable improvements to cost, quality, and throughput
  • Execute lean manufacturing principles to improve flow and eliminate waste

Workforce Development

  • Build and maintain a cross-trained team with no single points of failure
  • Facilitate training, coaching, and performance development

Standards and Discipline

  • Enforce high expectations for housekeeping, organization, and discipline
  • Maintain a clean, controlled, and efficient work environment

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Consistently meets or exceeds production targets
  • Improves efficiency, throughput, and cost performance over time
  • Maintains high inventory accuracy with no production disruptions tied to material issues
  • Builds a team that performs with minimal supervision
  • Eliminates recurring issues through root cause problem solving
  • Creates a culture of accountability and urgency

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Lean manufacturing experience including Kaizen, standard work, and waste elimination
  • Welding and fabrication experience
  • Experience with production metrics such as efficiency, throughput, and scrap
  • Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) or similar ERP systems

 

WHO YOU ARE (Non-Negotiables)

  • Self-driven and does not wait to be told what to do
  • Accountable and owns results, good or bad
  • Direct and communicates clearly while setting expectations
  • Resilient and performs under pressure
  • Results-oriented and focused on outcomes, not activity

 

WHO WILL STRUGGLE IN THIS ROLE

  • Avoids confrontation or accountability
  • Relies on others to solve problems
  • Hesitates to make decisions in real time
  • Accepts missed targets as normal

 

WHAT TOP PERFORMERS DO DIFFERENTLY

  • Run the floor constantly, not from a desk
  • Identify and act on issues before they impact production
  • Push both hourly and salaried teams to deliver results
  • Improve the process every week, not just maintain it
  • Build teams that perform even when they are not present

 

WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER:

  • Work Hours/Status: 
    • The 1st shift includes Monday - Friday 6:00am – 2:30pm.
    • Willingness to work every other Saturday during high-demand periods to support production requirements and meet customer commitments

SUMMARY:

The E-Coat Maintenance Tech is responsible for keeping the e-coat system running efficiently by monitoring and resolving common system shutdown faults and resolving other system problems. The role includes light duty preventive maintenance responsibilities, which include greasing equipment bearings, belt inspection and/or replacement, shut off valve replacement, and calibration of metering equipment. Other responsibilities include material handling 55-gallon drums of chemical using drum handling equipment, monitoring wastewater operation, and draining and cleaning tanks as needed.   

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitor and resolve system faults and make repairs as needed
  • Light duty preventive maintenance responsibilities
    • General equipment inspection and preventative maintenance
    • Replace filters
    • Calibrate meters and probes
    • Drain and fill processing tanks
  • Monitor waste-water discharge
  • Move incoming drums and totes of chemicals to the designated storage areas
  • Keep the system clean and organized

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:

  • Ability to troubleshoot problems
  • Ability to use hand tools
  • Ability to read equipment repair manuals and other work instructions

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Maintenance experience preferred but not required
  • Willingness to learn

Maintenance Manager Job Description

 

 

SUMMARY: 

The Maintenance Manager at Crenlo’s Rochester, MN production facility is a critical position within the Plant Engineering Team.  This individual has opportunity to lead and build a high performing team to administer the production and building maintenance functions.   The Maintenance Manager is a key member of the plant leadership team with responsibility for the uptime performance and preventive maintenance of equipment.  The role performs project planning for significant equipment repairs, upgrades, transfers and installations.  The Maintenance Manager leverages the maintenance management system to plan activities, execute work orders, and manage performance related to preventive maintenance, machine uptime, and similar metrics in support of production operations.

 

Salary Compensation: The compensation range for this position is $85,194 - $127,791 annually.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Takes ownership for the maintenance and uptime performance of production equipment and building / facility related systems.
  • Leads and builds the maintenance team to perform necessary tasks and projects for successful production operation and continuous improvement.
  • Develops the maintenance team culture to be proactive in planning maintenance work, continuously increase capabilities for root cause problem solving / troubleshooting, and urgent production support when needed.
  • Promotes a strong safety culture and follows all safety policies and procedures.
  • Utilizes the maintenance management system to plan and execute preventive maintenance activities and other planned work orders in collaboration with production operations.
  • Utilizes a work order tracking system to acknowledge maintenance requests from the organization and communicate status through completion.
  • Performs supervisory duties, in collaboration with Human Resources.
  • Facilitates training, coaching, and employee performance reviews, including cross training within the assigned area of responsibility. 
  • Provides planning for execution of projects related to equipment, buildings, and grounds.
  • Leads project planning, internally and externally with associates and contractors.  
  • Provides planning for procurement of required equipment and associated materials.
  • Supports capital expenditure analysis, evaluates cost to maintain vs cost to replace. 
  • Identifies and communicates workplace hazards and corrects or seeks assistance in correcting unsafe actions or conditions. 
  • Maintains a high level of housekeeping standards and organization of assigned work areas.  
  • Assists in the development and deployment of departmental policies and procedures.  
  • Communicates and enforces company policies and procedures while maintaining effective employee relations. 
  • Executes the Operations Annual Operating Plan (AOP) goals and objectives.  
  • Maintains working relationship with the union by following the terms of the collective bargaining agreement. 
  • Other duties as assigned. 

 

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES: 

  • Demonstrated team building skills are required.
  • A demonstrated commitment to utilize the maintenance management system, plan maintenance activities, and execute preventive maintenance and other projects is a requirement.
  • Problem prevention and problem-solving skills required. Must be solution oriented. 
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, leadership, and labor union representatives.  
  • Ability to recommend equipment and building repairs and upgrades. 
  • Proven ability to multitask with excellent time management skills. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate at all levels of the organization. 

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: 

  • Two year technical degree required. Four year degree preferred.  
  • Previous team leadership experience is required, with demonstrated success in building high performing teams.
  • Experience in a manufacturing environment (metal fabrication, welding, paint, assembly, or similar) is preferred.
  • Previous experience in a production maintenance function is preferred.

 

WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER: 

  • Work Hours/Status:  Mainly 1st shift hours with some overlap to 2nd shift for continuity. 
  • Environment:  Frequent exposure (34%-66%) to noise, odors, dust, drafts, chemicals, operating machinery, temperature extremes, hazardous substances, etc. 
  • Physical Requirements statement(s): Sitting/Standing, free to move around. Repetitive manual movements. 
  • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities.

SUMMARY 

The Commodity Manager plays a key role in developing and implementing sourcing strategies and strategic agreements for critical materials, components and/or assembly categories that facilitate lean procurement principles and optimize the capability, value and flexibility of the Crenlo supply chain. This position focuses on being results-driven, providing strong communications, attention to detail and the ability to influence decisions across the organization. This position is based out of our headquarters in Bentonville, Arkansas. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Works closely with the Company leadership team to ensure required suppliers, product capabilities and materials are available and meet cost targets in support of growth and a competitive position in the market. 
  • Develop sourcing strategies and implement plans for materials and components by geographic location that meet or exceed the business requirements. 
  • Provides input to company procurement, estimating and product development teams to leverage key supplier capabilities in product design, manufacture, test, cost reduction, lead time reduction and customer satisfaction. 
  • Performs technical and process capability and capacity assessments of potential and approved suppliers relative to assigned product responsibility to ensure cost effective solutions that meet all technical, performance, quality and business case requirements. 
  • Leads the development, implementation and management of innovative processes that facilitate the successful outsourcing or transition of selected products and/or services to offshore or domestic sources. 
  • Functions as the business liaison between the Company operational locations and external sourcing resources to facilitate timely resolution of technical and commercial issues. 
  • Facilitates and leads the negotiation and contract development of strategic business opportunities and long-term agreements, coordinating with all internal stakeholders involved in the process. 
  • Ensures compliance with product requirements, prompt resolution of supplier performance problems and proactive communication to site management teams of potential issues that may impact the customer if not properly managed. 
  • Engages in a spirit of cooperation throughout the internal and external supply chain organizations, engineering, manufacturing and quality to ensure superior customer satisfaction and results. 
  • Achieves defined milestones and performance targets on selected outsource, major subcontract and cost reduction implementations. 
  • Champions/ maintains and promotes a strong safety culture and follows all safety policies, procedures and regulations. Identifies and communicates workplace hazards and correct or seek assistance in correcting unsafe actions or conditions. 

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES 

  • Proven ability to develop and execute structured action plans that achieve Company goals 
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, lead and motivate multi-functional teams in a dynamic environment 
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work effectively independently as well as part of a wider team to deliver results 
  • Strong/broad knowledge of manufacturing processes, key market indicators and suppliers associated with raw materials and mechanical parts and assemblies 
  • Proven supplier management/engagement experience along with excellent organizational and process development/optimization skills 
  • A customer-oriented focus; be effective and creative in providing solutions in challenging situations. 
  • Strong ability to successfully manage multiple tasks/priorities at the same time. 
  • Ability to read and correctly interpret and communicate engineering drawings and specifications 
  • Will be expected to create and deliver presentations to management, other internal customers and suppliers 
  • Demonstrates solid negotiation and contract management skills 

WORKING CONDITIONS / OTHER 

  • Work Hours/Status: Full-Time, 40+ hours, Monday - Friday 
  • Travel Requirements: 20% Travel to company business locations and suppliers. 
  • Environment: Office working conditions. 
  • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities. 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS 

  • Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain or engineering or similar field of study, a master's degree preferred. 
  • Minimum of three (3) years previous experience as a Jr. Commodity Manager or Sr. Buyer, in a role that included price negotiation 
  • Minimum of five (5) years' experience in a manufacturing environment related to production or material planning, purchasing, inside sales or other supply chain functions 
  • Working knowledge of materials Requirements Planning (MRP), Lean manufacturing and replenishment methods and problem-solving tools 
  • Must be computer literate and highly proficient with Microsoft suite products. 
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 or AS9100 Quality System requirements and Lean Manufacturing techniques highly desired. 
  • Experience with international sourcing of materials preferred.

GENERAL SUMMARY: Perform repair and maintenance work on electronic control equipment and apparatus as associated with complex machine tools in a fast-paced steel manufacturing environment.

  • Installation, maintenance and repair of production or processing equipment and perform advanced troubleshooting.
  • Use appropriate test instruments to diagnose and locate the trouble and make needed repairs.

  • Report labor and job data accurately.
  • Maintain quality, safety and efficiency.

The Reliability Technician at Crenlo’s Rochester, MN production facility is a critical position within the Plant Engineering and Maintenance Team.  This individual has opportunity to utilize their technical expertise to drive improvements in production equipment reliability and uptime utilizing data analysis and the principles of preventive and predictive maintenance.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Takes ownership for the uptime performance of critical production equipment.
  • Performs troubleshooting on down equipment to investigate for repair actions as well as opportunities for preventive and predictive maintenance.
  • Utilizes the maintenance management system to create or update preventive and predictive maintenance procedures which are aimed at preventing future failures and maximizing machine uptime.
  • Utilizes equipment production data from machine interfaces, PLCs, and other sources to identify opportunities for improvements.
  • Analyzes data from vibration, infrared, and other diagnostic tools to detect early signs of equipment failure and schedule repairs during planned downtime.
  • Collaborates with engineers, maintenance team members, operators, supervisors, and third party vendors to identify and implement improvement plans.
  • Provides training for engineers, maintenance team members, and supervisors to support new methods of working to drive reliability improvements.
  • Supports planning for the execution of production equipment improvement projects.
  • Fosters productive working relationships with third party equipment vendors to identify and implement improvements.
  • Identifies and communicates workplace hazards and corrects or seeks assistance in correcting unsafe actions or conditions. 
  • Maintains a high level of housekeeping standards and organization of assigned work areas.  
  • Assists in the development and deployment of departmental policies and procedures.  
  • Other duties as assigned. 

 

 

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES: 

  • Expertise in general production equipment systems including mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical.
  • Expertise in integrated machine systems including PLC, common machine interfaces, and production and network data collection and storage.
  • Familiar with basic maintenance management systems.
  • Solid root cause troubleshooting skills and ability to drive thorough root cause analysis.
  • Effective team work skills
  • Problem prevention and problem-solving skills required. Must be solution oriented. 
  • Proven ability to multitask with excellent time management skills. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate at all levels of the organization. 

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: 

  • High school diploma required. Two year technical degree preferred.
  • Previous experience in a production maintenance function is preferred.

 

WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER: 

  • Work Hours/Status:  Mainly 1st shift hours with some overlap to 2nd shift for continuity. 
  • Environment:  Frequent exposure (34%-66%) to noise, odors, dust, drafts, chemicals, operating machinery, temperature extremes, hazardous substances, etc. 
  • Physical Requirements statement(s): Sitting/Standing, free to move around. Repetitive manual movements.

GENERAL SUMMARY:  Oversee workflow through department by assisting operators with set-ups and production on various machines.  Produce sheet metal parts to fill customer orders with the use of provided prints and bills of material, or supervisor instruction.  Responsible for accuracy in machine set-up, finished part dimensions and labor reporting.  Set up a variety of equipment including large brake press, turret, laser.  Operate under the principles of a cell environment, replenish parts, CI improvement, safety, quality, efficiency, delivery and cost.  Maintain 5s improvements.  Perform daily and routine maintenance.

 

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

·      Instruct and/or train new employees on various equipment as instructed by supervisor.

·      Complete daily standard work as instructed by supervisor.

·      Assign work for the Department in the absence of the supervisor.

·      Set up and operate a variety of equipment including Large Press Brake, Turret Press, Laser, Sweep Form Equipment and Pem Serter.

·      Operate under the principles of a cellular environment:

-       Become certified in all cell processes.

-       Replenishment of parts based on visual triggers, i.e., Kanban. 

-       Continuous improvement of quality, safety, delivery and cost.

-       Maintain daily control of process using SPC.

·      Maintain clean and organized work areas.

·      Work with basic computer programs. (Outlook, Word, Excel, Oracle, and other computer software as needed.)

·      Observe operator proficiency and re-instruct when necessary.

·      Ability to read and interpret manufacturing prints.

·      Ability to use measuring equipment to verify print dimensions.

·      Maintain a daily tracking of quality, safety, delivery and cost measures.

·      Report labor and job data accurately.

·      Perform other jobs within the department or plant as required by supervision.

·      May be responsible for buying some specialty tools as required.

 

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND QUALIFICATIONS:

 

EDUCATION:

High school diploma or equivalent preferred.  Ability to read and interpret manufacturing prints required.  Complete Company forklift and aerial lift training and maintain license/certification.

 

WORK EXPERIENCE:

Prior experience in a manufacturing environment is beneficial.  Must be proficient in the operation of the equipment listed above.

 

SKILLS:

A good command of the English language is required, both written and spoken.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills are required.  Operators are required to read and follow instructions on the prints, and route sheets.  Reporting and recording of results is required on all route sheets as per ISO procedure 44.  Should be able to check parts to print and do daily routine preventative maintenance of equipment including sharpening of tools. Computer and BAAN systems awareness and operation.  Candidate should be a self-starter and be able to communicate issues and improvements to other cell members and internal customers.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Must be able to physically perform essential functions of the job.  Must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10 lbs., frequently up to 24 lbs. and occasionally up to 100 lbs.  Typically requires standing on a regular basis, and walking, stooping (bending and twisting) and reaching occasionally.  Sheet metal parts are handled constantly throughout the day.  Specific vision requirements include depth perception and peripheral vision.

 

WORKING CONDITIONS:

SUMMARY:
Plans, positions, and welds fabricated and cast components on roll over/fall over protective structures, and specialized weldments. Performs work primarily on ROPS/FOPS structure welds completing all required welds, including sheet metal welds. Utilizes full-penetration, high critical joint welds without a backing material. Welds on all thickness, all joint types, and all positions. Assist in training requirements for all weld classifications and completion of required reports.
 
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Produces a product to customer quality standards in a safe and efficient manner.
* Lays out, positions, bolts, clamp, and tack-weld parts to secure into position within fixture for welding.
* Sets up and makes adjustments to equipment and parts per blueprints.
* Performs welding responsibilities on product outlined in Blueprints; OPI's, Quality Manual, or any additional performance guidelines.
* Grinds excess weld, sharp corners, or sharp protrusions using a portable pneumatic grinder.
* Makes periodic quality checks as required and inspects finished product for completeness.
* Aide in completion of 6GR testing for Weld 3 classification of new candidates
* Utilized as weld training contact for weld lines and provides mentoring to new welders
* Participates in Hi-Deposition Improvement Planning -- modification of weld procedures to increase safety, efficiency, and quality
* Assist in tracking recertification of welders on a monthly basis with follow-up to weld trainer
* Other duties as assigned
 
 
KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:
* Required to obtain weld certification to AWS/ANSI standards.
* Basic knowledge of welding procedures,
* Capability to read and interpret blueprints, work order instructions; weld symbols, and operate required tools involved in position.
* Good problem-solving skills, safety practices and attention to quality.
* Ability to convert standard units of measure to metric and metric to standard in addition to basic math skills.
* Able to consistently maintain production averages at or above the expected standards.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:
* Minimum of a high school diploma or GED
* Successful completion of Crenlo Engineered Cabs weld training program requirements, including 6GR certification
* Crenlo basic safety training
* 3 to 5 years weld experience
* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities.

Summary

 

The Operational Finance Analyst will be directly involved in oversight of our Std Cost System as well as being a key driver of execution of our Business and Margin Analysis across our facilities/business units.  The role will help ensure accuracy and integrity of cost and inventory data, support operational efficiency, and provide actionable insights to drive financial performance.  The ideal candidate combines strong analytical expertise, a deep understanding and curiosity of manufacturing processes, and solid experience and versatility in the use of different systems and current data-mining techniques and technical tools.  Experience with Oracle ERP systems is helpful as well. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Leadership & Analysis
    • Provide strategic insights on gross margins, manufacturing variances, and product-line profitability.
    • Conduct variance analysis (material, labor, overhead, and PPV) and partner with operations to implement corrective actions.
    • Partner with Plant Controllers, operation, engineering and sales to improve decision-making on pricing, cost control, and resource utilization.
  • Cost System & ERP Management
    • Manage and maintain the ERP cost accounting and costing systems, including annual cost roll and labor updates.
    • Develop and standardize cost accounting processes across plants to ensure data integrity and consistency.
    • Collaborate with IT and ERP teams to enhance system functionality and reporting accuracy.
  • Inventory Management
    • Be involved with inventory valuation, reconciliation, and reporting to ensure accuracy and compliance.
    • Collaborate with operations to improve inventory control and cycle count accuracy.
    • Monitor and analyze inventory turnover, excess, and obsolescence trends to minimize write-offs.
    • Support inventory optimization initiatives to align working capital with production and demand planning.
    • Ensure Oracle ERP inventory modules reflect accurate and current data for production and finance reporting.

 

  • Operational Support & Continuous Improvement & Compliance
    • Lead cost reduction and efficiency initiatives, including cost avoidance, process automation, and waste reduction.
    • Support external and internal audit requirements as needed.

Position Summary 

The Customer Liaison serves as the primary on-the-ground connection between Crenlo and its OEM customers and partners. This role builds and sustains strategic customer relationships, resolves technical and quality issues at the source, and represents both the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Crenlo externally. The position requires strong technical fluency, particularly the ability to read and interpret manufacturing prints and specifications, along with the interpersonal skill to manage sensitive relationships under pressure. In its early phase, this role may also include oversight of temporary labor at OEM plant locations to support new product and quality needs. 

Key Responsibilities 

Strategic Relationship Management 

  • Serve as the trusted point of contact for assigned OEM customers, building long-term, strategic relationships based on proactivity and credibility. 
  • Represent customer priorities internally to engineering, quality, and operations teams, and represent Crenlo's capabilities and constraints to the customer. 
  • Travel regularly to customer and manufacturing sites to maintain face-to-face presence and strengthen partnerships. 
  • Anticipate customer needs and concerns before they escalate, and proactively communicate status on open issues. 

Technical Problem Solving 

  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues raised by customers or discovered on the plant floor, working cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to drive resolution. 
  • Read and interpret manufacturing prints, blueprints, GD&T, and technical specifications to evaluate conformance and communicate discrepancies clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action processes (such as 8D or similar structured problem-solving methods). 
  • Translate technical findings into clear, customer-facing communication. 

Quality Assurance 

  • Support efforts to secure and maintain product quality across manufacturing locations, acting as an on-site advocate for customer quality expectations. 
  • Partner with plant quality teams to verify that corrective actions are implemented and effective. 
  • Monitor recurring issues and escalate systemic concerns to leadership. 
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting customer audits or quality reviews as needed. 

Temporary Labor Management (Initial Phase) 

  • In the early stages of this role, may directly oversee temporary labor resources at OEM plant locations to support production continuity and quality initiatives. 
  • Coordinate scheduling, onboarding, and daily direction of temporary staff in partnership with plant leadership. 
  • Ensure temporary labor practices align with safety, quality, and company standards. 

Cross-Functional Coordination 

  • Act as a liaison between corporate functions (sales, engineering, quality) and plant-level operations across Watertown, Rochester, and Greeneville facilities. 
  • Communicate updates, risks, and opportunities across teams to keep customer commitments on track. 
  • Support new program launches and product changes from a customer and quality standpoint. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, manufacturing, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
  • 3-5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, manufacturing environment, quality role, or similar, ideally in the off-highway, heavy equipment, or industrial vehicle industry. 
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret manufacturing prints, blueprints, and technical drawings, including GD&T. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills with experience in structured root cause analysis methods. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail for varied audiences. 
  • Comfortable and effective building relationships in person, including with customers and plant personnel. 
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently, including to manufacturing plants and customer locations. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools (Outlook, Excel, Teams, Word). 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience working within Oracle EBS or similar ERP systems. 
  • Familiarity with quality systems and standards common in the off-highway or industrial vehicle industry (such as ISO 9001). 
  • Experience supporting new program launches or product introductions with OEM customers. 

Work Environment and Physical Requirements 

  • Split time between office, manufacturing floor, and customer site environments. 
  • Ability to safely navigate a manufacturing plant floor, including wearing required personal protective equipment. 
  • Frequent travel by car and air, including overnight and multi-day trips. 
  • Valid driver's license required.

  • Develop design solutions and manufacturing solutions based on an understanding of internal and external manufacturing processes and capabilities.
  • Conducts product design revision implementation and incorporate facility feedback of design revision execution to optimize cost and quality.
  • Collaborate with Global Engineering team to solve product performance challenges
  • Provides concise and effective technical guidance and communication to internal and external customers; builds effective technical communication paths with internal and external customers.
  • Serves as a customer-facing liaison to resolve current production design-based issues, accurately define and deliver on customer requested production improvements and changes.
  • Develop product design improvements using as a tool CREO-Parametric 4.0 (or higher versions)
  • Makes 3D mathematic models and 2D detailed drawings.
  • Manages the files (drawings) on CREO or PDF format within their respective revisions and releases using PTC-Windchill 11.1 (or higher versions
  • Identifies design optimization and cost reduction projects
  • Supports department KPI and TTI metrics to meet goals via assigned/proposed projects
  • Collaborates with Company stakeholders to develop/improve process/system performance challenges
  • Maintains and continuously improves key Engineering Change Processes and Systems – system design updates through feedback, data access and metrics
  • Manages and executes process and systems design of cross-functional systems and processes; complex model year change programs and other projects as assigned.

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:

  • Evidence of proficiency in performing engineering calculations
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
  • Flexibility and adaptability to change
  • Demonstrated ability to produce accurate detailed models and drawings
  • Strong manufacturing support
  • Individual and team problem solving skills
  • Advanced Steel structure, sheet metal part design, component assembly experience
  • Demonstrated and effective project team leadership
  • Strong understanding of Geometrical Dimensioning & Tolerancing requirements
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing process capabilities for optimal design for manufacturability.

WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER:

  • Work Hours/Status: Full-time, 40+ hours/week, Monday through Friday, weekends required as needed.
  • Travel Requirements: up to 10%
  • Environment: The work environment is both office as well as shop floor where numerous processes (cutting, welding, grinding, press brake forming, painting, and assembly) are under constant operation. Shop conditions include frequent exposure (30 – 60%) to noise, odors, dust, drafts, chemicals, operating machinery, temperature extremes, and hazardous substances.
  • Physical Requirements statement(s) Sustained visual concentration on small areas, such as monitors and screens is required. Sitting, standing, and frequent walking are required.
  • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities.

Ken Garner Manufacturing was started in 1984 in Chattanooga, TN, and has added production locations in Rural Hall, NC and Victoria, Texas. We are a manufacturer of high tonnage deep-drawn parts, finished steel weldments, and a large number of counterweights for Heavy Equipment and Mobile Cranes. Our customers are OEMs in these fields and other heavy industries.

  • We offer a competitive salary and an excellent benefits package
  • Equal Opportunity Employer
  • Notice: Drug Free Workplace
  • All applicants are subject to pre-employment drug test and background check.
","jobs":[{"title":"(Weekend / Night Shift) Highly Skilled MIG Welders","shortcode":"4DADC685BD","code":"","employment_type":"Full-time","telecommuting":false,"department":"Fabrication","url":"https://apply.workable.com/j/4DADC685BD","shortlink":"https://apply.workable.com/j/4DADC685BD","application_url":"https://apply.workable.com/j/4DADC685BD/apply","published_on":"2026-06-09","created_at":"2023-10-20","country":"United States","city":"Chattanooga","state":"Tennessee","education":"Vocational","experience":null,"function":"Manufacturing","industry":"Machinery","locations":[{"country":"United States","countryCode":"US","city":"Chattanooga","region":"Tennessee","hidden":false}],"description":"

This full-time position is an opportunity for HIGHLY skilled welders to produce finished weldments for heavy equipment. Finish weld primarily mild steel using MIG process; read and weld to provided prints, understand bills of material and welding symbols, operate hand grinders, drills, overhead cranes, and miscellaneous measurement and hand tools.

We are actively hiring skilled welders (MIG) with the ability to finish weld on our weekend or night shift. Weekend shift works 5:00 am-5:30 pm, Friday – Sunday, and night shift works Mon-Thurs 4:00 pm-2:00 am, both shifts receive a $2.50 / hour shift differential. Overtime is occasionally available.

Requirements

MUST BE ABLE TO PASS A DRUG TEST, Also pass a respirator fit test which means a very tightly trimmed beard or no beard at all!

All tools, equipment and supplies are provided, with the exception of Steel Toe Shoes.

Applications are accepted in person at 1201 E 28th St, Chattanooga, TN 37404.

Must bring 2 of the following to interview:

  • Valid ID/ Driver’s license (either way it needs to be govt. issued)
  • SS card
  • Birth Cert (original or certified copy)
  • Military ID
  • Valid Passport

Benefits

Employees are eligible for a full benefit package:

10 paid holidays + 1 week vacation after 6 months, 2 weeks after 18 months, 3 weeks after 5 years, 4 weeks after 10.

Medical, dental and vision insurance is offered at very reasonable rates. Family coverage is approximately $100 per week.

Company paid life insurance for employee, optional coverage is available for family at additional discounted cost.

Uniforms provided. Pay is weekly. Regularly scheduled performance reviews.

"}]}
